text:
lee: Hi team, quick onboarding snag. I'm demoing a small PoC with the hosted API from my laptop behind company proxy + VPN and I'm intermittently hitting 429s and sometimes the TCP stream drops during streaming responses. Anyone know the low-friction path to get a short hosted quota bump for a demo, and are there specific IP ranges or proxy rules we should ask IT to allow?
onboard-bot: Welcome Lee! :wave: For quota bumps ping #eng or DM dev-admin. Also check the new-hire checklist at https://redwood.dev/onboarding for proxy/egress notes.
dev-admin: Hey @lee, we can do a 48-72 hour demo bump for hosted keys. Submit a quick form in the #eng channel or DM me the root timestamp + intended time window. If this is recurring, consider switching to a sandbox/demo key.
infra: If your corporate proxy terminates TLS or mutates chunked responses it can break streaming. For troubleshooting try: 1) run curl -v off-VPN (phone hotspot) 2) include -N / --no-buffer when streaming to avoid buffering effects 3) capture the `x-request-id` and any `x-rate-limit-*` headers.
sre-ops: We can look up traces if you give us an `x-request-id`. For 429s check `x-rate-limit-remaining` and `x-rate-limit-reset`; sometimes proxies re-use connections and IP-based buckets trigger limits. If you can't get off VPN, ask IT to whitelist `api.redwood.ai` and the egress CIDR listed on the infra docs.
lee: here's the failing curl (from behind VPN):
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-hosted-ABCD" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"model":"rwd-1-medium","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}' -v
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Headers included `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-request-id: req_9a8b7c`, no `retry-after`. Also saw TLS connection reset occasionally (curl exit 56).
security: Hosted keys are not tied to interactive MFA for API calls. Standard practice: store API tokens in a secrets manager (Vault/Secrets Manager) and don't paste them in channels. If IT needs to allow hostnames, give them `api.redwood.ai` and the egress list; they shouldn't request the secret.
dev-admin: For an immediate workaround we can provision a short-lived sandbox key (separate quota) or issue ephemeral creds via Vault for the demo. If you want the hosted bump, reply here with the demo window and I'll route the request.
lee: Thanks — I'll try tethering off VPN and then DM dev-admin with the demo dates. I'll also paste the `x-request-id` if it happens again. Appreciate it! :thumbsup:
